description: Difficulty-dependent enemies of map1_s02 (School Otherworld - 1F and courtyard): on Easy some rows of Creeper and GreyChild are emptied ("none"), on Hard more rows get spawn bits, as the original's Easy/Hard blocks did. Spawns that depend on story flags during play stay in the map's Lua. Each entry has "when" (all of: "difficulty" easy/normal/hard, "flags_set" and "flags_clear" event flag names that must be set / clear; nested "all"/"any" lists combine conditions) and "set", a list of writes: "chara" is a character name, "slot" the row of the map's spawn table for that character (as the second argument of sh.chara_spawn_flags_set) and "flags" the spawn flags the row gets, which the spawned character starts its state from ("none" = 0, the row stays empty; spawn_0.. spawn_4 are the bits). Entries apply when the map loads, in file order (a later one wins); a mod's own entries are appended unless they carry an "id" that replaces an entry.
